summary: Logs MIDI messages entering or leaving TouchDesigner through active MIDI operators, with FIFO storage, filters, and per-packet callbacks.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Enable MIDI event logging

key_params.name: skipsense
key_params.note: Do not log MIDI active sensing messages

key_params.name: skiptiming
key_params.note: Do not report MIDI timing messages

key_params.name: filter
key_params.note: Enable MIDI message filter parameters

key_params.name: message
key_params.note: Filter by MIDI message content

key_params.name: channel
key_params.note: Filter by MIDI channel in the 1-16 range

key_params.name: index
key_params.note: Filter by MIDI message index in the 1-128 range

key_params.name: value
key_params.note: Filter by MIDI value in the 0-127 range

key_params.name: dir
key_params.note: Filter by MIDI direction, input or output

key_params.name: callbacks
key_params.note: Callback DAT called for each received MIDI packet

key_params.name: executeloc
key_params.note: Choose where callback scripts execute from

key_params.name: fromop
key_params.note: Operator context used when Execute From is set to Specified Operator

key_params.name: clamp
key_params.note: Limit FIFO output to a bounded number of messages

key_params.name: maxlines
key_params.note: Maximum retained message rows when Clamp Output is on

key_params.name: clear
key_params.note: Clear all logged rows except the heading

key_params.name: bytes
key_params.note: Include raw MIDI bytes in the output

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: language
key_params.note: Common DAT script-language selection

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: No messages appear unless active MIDI In or MIDI Out operators are configured to receive or send messages.
Controller indices are 1-based in the 1-128 range, unlike many zero-based programming APIs.
Callbacks run once per packet and can be high frequency for clocks or controllers.
Direction filtering matters when the project has both inbound and outbound MIDI traffic.
key_concepts: Receives MIDI events from the Perform mode event stream and writes them to a DAT table.
Filter, message, channel, index, value, and direction parameters constrain captured MIDI messages.
Skip Sense and Skip Timing can suppress high-volume MIDI timing/status traffic.
Callbacks and FIFO retention controls shape event handling and table size.
